 Order

1. Accused in Crime No.152/2023 registered by Ron Police Station, Gadag district for the offences punishable under Sections 376 and 306 of Indian Penal Code is before this Court under Section 439 of Cr.P.C.
2. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

3. FIR in Crime No.152/2023 was registered by Ron Police Station, Gadag district against the petitioner herein initially for the offences punishable under Sections 376 and 306 IPC on the basis of the complaint lodged by Balavva who is the mother of the deceased.
In her complaint dated 29.08.2022, the complainant has averred that her husband Shekharappa was working as driver in K.S.R.T.C. and they have 7 children.
The deceased was their third daughter.
The petitioner who hails from the very same village was pestering the deceased and was forcing her to marry him.
The complainant and her husband allegedly had advised the petitioner and asked him not to force their daughter.
About 3 days prior to the NC: 2024:KHC-D:980 date of complaint, the complainant had gone to her parents house.
On 29.8.2023 at about 12.15 pm, she had returned to her house.
The door of the house was locked from inside.
Therefore, the complainant knocked the door.
Her daughter who is the victim in the present case opened the door.
She looked frightened.

When the complainant enquired, she started weeping and informed the complainant that the petitioner had come to their house at about 11.30 am and after locking the door from inside, he promised to marry the victim and had sexually assaulted her against her wish.
The complainant informed the same to her husband who returned home at about 2.00pm.
After the complainants husband returned home, the victim allegedly ran out from the house.
The husband of the complainant also ran behind her.
Subsequently, he was informed by CW10-Kavita that the victim had jumped to their well.
The complainant's husband also jumped to the well and tried to find his daughter but he could not.
Thereafter, the complainant's husband and others informed the Fire department, who came to their village NC: 2024:KHC-D:980 and recovered the dead body of the deceased from the well.

It is in this background a complaint was lodged on 29.08.2023.
4.
During the course of investigation, the petitioner was arrested on 30.08.2023.
Investigation in the case was completed and charge sheet was filed.
Bail application filed by the petitioner before the Trial Court in Crl.Misc.No.429/2023 was rejected on 22.11.2023.
Therefore, he is before this Court.

sentences.text: Learned counsel for the petitioner having reiterated the grounds urged in the petition prays to allow the petition.
6. Per contra, the learned High Court Government Pleader has opposed the bail application.
7. The victim is the third daughter of the complainant and her husband Shekharappa.

The material on record would go to show that she was aged about 20 years and after discontinuing her studies,
she was staying NC: 2024:KHC-D:980 at home.
On 29.08.2023, the complainant who had gone to her parents house, had returned to her house at about 12.15 pm and since the door of the house was locked from inside, she had knocked the door.
The complainant's daughter who is the victim in the present case had opened the door and complainant found that she looked frightened.

On enquiry by the complainant, she was allegedly informed by the victim that the petitioner who had come to their house at about 11.30am, after locking the door from inside, had committed sexual assault on her against her wishes.
The complainant thereafter had informed her husband who was on duty.
He allegedly came home at about 2.00pm on 29.08.2023.
It is only after the complainant's husband came home, the victim ran out of the house and committed suicide.
The material on record would go to show that there are many other houses situated adjacent to the house of the complainant.
The alleged incident of forcible sexual assault had taken place inside the house during the day time.
The medical records available on record does not speak about forcible NC: 2024:KHC-D:980 sexual assault on the victim.
The petitioner has no criminal antecedents.
The investigation in the case is completed and charge sheet was filed.
The petitioner is in custody from 30.08.2023.
He is aged about 26 years.
Under these circumstances, I am of the opinion that, the prayer made by the petitioner in the application for regular bail is required to be answered in the affirmative.

Accordingly, the following:
ORDER Petition is allowed.

The petitioner is directed to be enlarged on bail in Crime No.152/2023 registered by Ron Police Station, Gadag district for the offences punishable under Sections 376 and 306 of Indian Penal Code, subject to the following conditions:
i.
The petitioner shall execute personal bond for a sum of Rs.1,00,000/- with two sureties for the likesum to the satisfaction the trial Court.
NC: 2024:KHC-D:980 ii.
The petitioner shall attend Trial Court regularly on all dates of hearing unless his appearance is exempted by the Trial Court for valid reasons.

iii.
The petitioner shall not directly or indirectly tamper with the prosecution witnesses.
iv. The petitioner shall not involve in similar offences in future.

Sd/-
